thread:
vikas: CI microbench failed on PR 7988 — noticed p95 token latency jump ~12% on A100 runners after the merge. repro on CI snapshot. :eyes:
sue: link? stacktrace? which bench?
vikas: microbench/kvcache_warmup and batcher_latency tests. perf-bot output attached in the CI artifact. failing threshold: p95 tokens/sec drop beyond -10%.
perf-bot: automated perf alert for PR 7988
perf-bot: benchmark: kvcache_warmup (A100-40GB)
perf-bot: baseline p95: 48.2 tokens/ms, PR p95: 42.5 tokens/ms, delta: -11.9% (threshold -10%)
perf-bot: artifact: https://ci.internal/redwood/7988/artifacts/perf.out
miguel: assigning to me to bisect. can repro locally with the CI container (./ci/run_microbench.sh --bench=kvcache_warmup).
miguel: quick bisect points to commit 4a7b2c9 — "scheduler: prefetch window heuristic adjust" — suspicious.
olga: that patch changed prefetch window and kernel affinity hints. small change but could affect warmup prefetch ordering.
vikas: can you paste profiler output / flame?
olga: dropping profiler snippet below — heatmap is the interesting bit (hot = red):
```
kernel_selector:      ||||||||||||||||||||||||||||||||||||||  (30%)
kv_prefetcher:        ||||||||||||||||||||||||||||||        (25%)
batch_coordinator:    ||||||||||||||||||||                  (18%)
cuda_copy_wait:       ||||||||||||||                       (12%)
sync_barrier:         |||||||                             (8%)
other:                |||||                               (7%)
```
miguel: looks like prefetcher now schedules more speculative KV pulls for long sequences which increases kernel_selector contention and delays first token latency.
sue: any quick mitigation we can try before full revert?
miguel: tested locally: reverting just the prefetch window change (256 -> 128) in the scheduler drops p95 back to 49.0 tokens/ms (baseline ~48.2). patch diff is tiny.
vikas: can you push a hotfix PR that reverts that one line? we should also add a microbench that simulates skewed sequence-length distribution to catch this.
miguel: will open PR 7990 with hotfix + new test.
olga: also adding a perf-gate config to CI to catch prefetch-induced kernel contention: run kvcache_warmup on both uniform and long-tail seq distributions.
sue: +1. without this the rollout for 7988 should be blocked until hotfix merges. tagging @eng-oncall per SLAs. :hammer:
ci-bot: created PR 7990 branch hotfix/microbench-prefetch-revert and started CI. https://ci.internal/redwood/pulls/7990
perf-bot: rerun microbench on PR 7990 (A100) — preliminary p95: 49.1 tokens/ms, delta vs baseline: +1.9%
vikas: thanks. once green we'll merge and un-block rollout for 7988. follow-up: evaluate smarter kernel affinity hints rather than naive prefetch window shrink.
sue: noted. adding a ticket to triage longer-term fix (TICKET-1257).
miguel: leaving a short postmortem in the PR describing why change regressed warmup perf and how the added test prevents it.
vikas: nice work everyone. keep the revert small and land fast. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: PR 7990 CI passed: all microbench thresholds within limits.
vikas: merging 7990 now, rollout resumed for main.
ci-bot: deploy pipeline kicked off for main.
